title: Contractor or employee? How the IRS decides
label: Owner pay 101

link.label: Do I need to send a 1099? checker (MFA)

lines: Ben pays a helper as a contractor.
Ben sets his hours and trains him.

items.s: Do you decide how the work is done?
Who pays expenses and supplies the tools?
Benefits? Ongoing? Core to your business?

beats.sub: Unsure? Form SS-8 asks the IRS to decide.

captions.instagram:
Calling someone a contractor doesn't make them one. The IRS looks at the whole relationship.

✔️ Control: do you decide how the work is done?
✔️ Money: who pays the expenses and supplies the tools?
✔️ Relationship: benefits, ongoing work, work that's core to your business?
✔️ Treat an employee as a contractor without a reasonable basis and you may owe the employment taxes.
✔️ Still unsure? Either side can file Form SS-8 to ask the IRS.

Paying contractors this year? Our 1099 checker shows who needs a form.

captions.youtube_description: The IRS looks at the right to control how work is done, using three kinds of evidence: behavioral control, financial control and the type of relationship. Misclassifying an employee without a reasonable basis can leave you owing employment taxes. Form SS-8 asks the IRS for a determination.
